These are the slides of a company's investor presentation.
List every claim on them that states a number someone could check against company documents
(amounts, percentages, counts, years). Skip the terms of the proposed transaction.

For each claim return: slide (the page number), quote (the exact sentence from the slide),
metric (a short name), value (the number only), unit ("%", "$M", "count" or "year"),
period (for example "FY2025", or "" if none).

Return JSON: {"claims": [{"slide": 0, "quote": "", "metric": "", "value": 0, "unit": "", "period": ""}]}

Rules:
- Use only the passages given. Never use outside knowledge.
- Copy quotes exactly, word for word, from one passage. Keep a quote short: the sentence or table row that holds the figure.
- Report facts only. Never give advice, opinions or recommendations.
- Return valid JSON only.

Slides:
[01_investor_presentation:p1:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.1, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Payments and reconciliation for mid-size retailers) Confidential. Prepared for prospective co-investors. October 2026.
[01_investor_presentation:p2:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.2, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Company) Founded in 2014. 3 offices: London, Manchester, Dublin.
[01_investor_presentation:p3:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.3, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > The problem we solve) Mid-size retailers run payments and reconciliation in separate tools. Finance teams close the month by matching card settlements to orders by hand.
[01_investor_presentation:p4:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.4, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Financials) Revenue FY2025: $38.0M. Profitable and growing.
[01_investor_presentation:p5:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.5, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Unit economics) Gross margin: 68%. Net revenue retention: 115%.
[01_investor_presentation:p6:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.6, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Customers) 410 customers across the UK and Ireland. Largest customer: 12% of revenue.
[01_investor_presentation:p7:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.7, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Product) 3 products: FinPay, FinRecon, FinInsights.
[01_investor_presentation:p8:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.8, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Team) 240 employees. Led by CEO Daniel Okafor and CFO Priya Raman.
[01_investor_presentation:p9:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.9, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > Financing) Senior term loan: $25.0M.
[01_investor_presentation:p10:u1] (01_investor_presentation.pdf p.10, Fintech A: Investor Presentation > The transaction) Northgate Capital Partners is acquiring a 30% stake for $60.0M. Co-investment is available.
